items.text: A stashed pane on Linux leaves the layout and comes back to its slot.
On Linux, +new-remote-window opens a window on a remote machine's agent.
A new tab in a remote Linux window opens on that machine.
Relay windows on Linux come back at relaunch, re-attached to the same far shell.
The Settings window appears at once; its theme catalog loads behind it.
The dashboard server restarts itself onto new code after task-dashboard.js changes.
The dashboard reload test ends red, not green, if its section aborts.
An 8-pane divider drag fits the two-frame budget again; T2459 already fixed it.
